boxes.label: FIZZ2.EXE main
boxes.text: Sets the x87 control word, hooks IRQ 0 (and IRQ 1 for /LIVE), runs the rules at 60 Hz, and prints the transcript and the platform lines. Checked by `tools/check-dos.sh` in headless DOSBox.

boxes.label: Episode 2 game
boxes.text: The program plays one small slice level. The rest of the game, with its levels, gadgets and enemies, is planned.

boxes.label: fizz-sim
boxes.text: `no_std`, no `unsafe`, no platform types. Host tests, and the same hash on native, Web and DOS.

boxes.label: fizz-ep2
boxes.sub: Ben, the chicken, the slice level
boxes.text: The slice's rules, built on fizz-phys, with a golden replay that native, Web and DOS reproduce. It replaced the Milestone 0 marker rules, `fizz-hello`, which are deleted.

boxes.label: lf-sim from Fizz 1
boxes.text: Reused or ported, and proved with a Fizz 1 trace.

boxes.label: fizz-present-dos
boxes.text: Integer only (`clippy::float_arithmetic` denied). Host tests of the slice HUD and banner.

boxes.label: Scene intent projection
boxes.text: Lowering tiles, sprites and lights to mode 13h. A sketch only.

boxes.label: DosClock, DosInput, DosDisplay
boxes.text: The only place the HAL traits meet the runtime. `DosClock` and `WebClock` are the two consumers of `Clock` and `Pacer`.

boxes.label: timer.rs
boxes.text: Divisor 19886 and a 16-bit accumulator that chains to the BIOS handler; `BIOS TICKS 182` over the 600-tick Milestone 0 replay.

boxes.label: kbd.rs
boxes.text: Scancodes into a local ring; `MOVED yes` from DOSBox autotype in `/LIVE`.

boxes.label: vga.rs
boxes.text: Real-mode `INT 10h` through DPMI. The picture itself has not been looked at on a real display.

boxes.label: fpu.rs
boxes.text: `FPU CW 027F` after the replay.

boxes.label: start.rs, dpmi.rs, heap.rs
boxes.text: Mirrored from Desk's d0 spike and the proof of concept.

boxes.label: irq.rs
boxes.text: Handlers return `Eoi` or `Chain`, do bounded work and never touch the x87.

boxes.label: cleanup.rs, panic.rs
boxes.sub: vectors restored on exit and panic
boxes.text: `VECTORS RESTORED yes`, and `/PANIC` exits with status 3.

boxes.label: rust-lld, link.ld, elf2go32.py
boxes.sub: ELF to go32 with the DJGPP stub
boxes.text: No C compiler or C library. `FIZZ2.EXE` is 61,440 bytes unstripped (32,768 at Milestone 0).

boxes.label: dos-elf.json, -Zbuild-std
boxes.text: Built in the pinned `ci-dos` image in CI and from `vendor/` locally.

boxes.label: CWSDPMI and DOS
boxes.text: Not ours. Under CWSDPMI `hlt` is privileged, so pacing spins on the tick counter.

boxes.label: DOSBox Staging 0.83.0
boxes.text: Every DOS result so far. `cycles=max` hides x87 cost.

boxes.label: A real 486DX
boxes.text: No physical machine or display has run FIZZ2.EXE.
